summary: Pineapple Financial (NYSE American: PAPL), a Canadian-domiciled mortgage fintech, filed an 8-K reporting a CFO transition. On October 9, 2026, the board approved appointing Usman Maher as CFO and Chief Strategy Officer effective October 15, 2026; incumbent Syed Sarfraz Habib becomes Chief Accounting Officer and Controller, with no stated disagreement. Maher receives a $250,000 base salary accruing October 1, 2026, a 100% target bonus (50%-150% range), and future equity awards. The filing also includes Regulation FD and other-event disclosures. Watch for reporting or governance friction around the dual-CFO structure.
